recommendations.title: Make agent verdicts binding: a CHANGES NEEDED / FAIL completion must not unblock successors
recommendations.target: orchestrator unblock cascade for review/verification tasks (code_reviewer, qa_verifier, ci_agent)
recommendations.description: Require a structured verdict field on agent.complete for review/QA/CI personas (PASS | CHANGES_NEEDED | FAIL | BLOCKED). On any non-PASS verdict: do not emit orchestrator.unblocked for the successor; instead set the successor's blockedBy += the spawned fix ticket(s) and re-create (or re-open) the verdict-owning ticket for round N+1 once the fix completes. In dowtdh both TEAM-4180 (CHANGES NEEDED) and TEAM-4181 (FAIL) unblocked their successors and the run completed on an unverified head.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Eliminates verdict-blind completion; QA/CI can only certify the head that will be handed off/merged. Directly closes the unverified-follow-on-fix gap (3 runs) and the QA-parallel-with-fix pattern (3 runs).

recommendations.title: Fix tickets must pin downstream verification: QA and CI re-run at the fix head before completion
recommendations.target: software-delivery def: codex_fix / ship_fix / ci_fix ticket template + completion condition
recommendations.description: When a fix ticket is created under the epic, add it to blockedBy of every not-yet-done QA/CI ticket, and register a 'Re-verify (round N)' QA + CI pair blocked on the fix. Workflow completion condition: 0 open fix tickets AND last QA/CI completion SHA == integration head SHA. In dowtdh the completion fired 3s after TEAM-4183 with QA at 933ea6f, CI at 12e9ac6, head at 001259d. f50ucz showed the right shape ad hoc (ship-review r2 + TEAM-4157 CI re-cert) - make it def-level.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Handed-off/merged head is always the verified head; removes the standing P1 that has now recurred 3 times.

recommendations.title: Bind human-gate decisions to a tracked Decision record that downstream artifacts must reference
recommendations.target: playbook overlay: Spec Approval / Design Approval / Plan Approval gates + designer/dev prompts
recommendations.description: When a PO/engineer resolves a Concern at a gate, write it to .sdlc/<wf>/decisions.md (id, gate ticket, text, status). Designer/planner prompts must either implement each open decision or file an explicit Deviation row and re-route to the decision owner BEFORE the next gate. Plan Approval reviewer package should surface 'decisions not honored' as a checklist. In dowtdh Concern 3 (pause on focus/hover, TEAM-4174/TEAM-4176) was contradicted by design and plan with 'Deviations: None yet.' and only surfaced as reviewer F1 (P1), costing the TEAM-4183 loop (1,731,344ms).
recommendations.expectedImpact: Removes the class of 'unrecorded deviation' P1s; makes human-gate time convert into binding requirements instead of advisory text.

recommendations.title: humanWait metric: key gate resolution on the gate's agent.complete/unblock, not the Jira transition
recommendations.description: Use the earliest of (gate ticket agent.complete, orchestrator.unblocked whose unblockedBy == gate ticket) as resolvedAt; fall back to the Jira transition only when neither exists. Flag as 'bookkeeping-batched' when several gates resolve within <60s of each other long after their unblocks. dowtdh: metric says 7,111,793ms across 4 gates; unblocks happened at 21:48:32 / 22:09:40 / 22:30:31 / 22:45:27 while all four Jira closes landed 22:45:16-24.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Restores humanWait as a real friction signal and stops batch-closes from polluting the def baseline bands.

recommendations.title: Emit a structured verdict event so rework metrics stop reading 0 on rejected runs
recommendations.target: orchestrator agent.complete payload + performance card quality block
recommendations.description: Add detail.verdict and detail.spawnedTickets to agent.complete for review/QA/CI personas; compute reworkRounds/gateRounds/firstPassYield from those instead of change-request events. dowtdh perf card: reworkRounds 0, gateRounds 0, firstPassYield 1 on a CHANGES NEEDED + FAIL run.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Rework visibility in dashboards and SI batching without parsing summary prose.

recommendations.title: Populate SDLC Framework and Human Review Gates blocks in the intake Workflow Context for playbook runs
recommendations.description: TEAM-4164 reported both blocks missing and reconstructed conventions from wf_1788672380233_ymo7dm's artifacts. Ship the blocks from the def + input.sdlcFramework so the analyst never depends on a prior run existing.
recommendations.expectedImpact: Removes a silent single point of failure for the first playbook run in any new repo; small reduction in analyst tokens (1,172,864ms task).

recommendations.title: Per-task cost attribution in cost-report.json
recommendations.description: agentTasks entries carry durationMs but usd/personaUsd/codingUsd are null, so the $450.02 total (2.35x ymo7dm's $191.21) cannot be attributed to the gate review packages vs. verification vs. fix loop. Attribute by coding-session id and persona invocation window.

summaryMarkdown:
# Run analysis — wf_1788731227559_dowtdh · "Clear the Activity feed with an undo window"

workflowDefId=software-delivery · sdlcFramework=playbook (2nd playbook validation run) · outcome=complete · trigger=auto
Repo: tycenjmccann/demo-app · delivery=handoff (CD_REGISTERED=false) · PR #47 handed off at workflow.complete
Started 2026-09-06T21:47:08.575Z → completed 23:46:58.351Z · totalDurationMs=7,189,776 (~2h0m)

## Verdict

A fast, well-specified playbook run whose code reviewer and QA verifier both caught real defects
(P1 unrecorded PO-decision deviation + 3 a11y/edge findings) — and whose orchestrator then ignored
both verdicts. Review said CHANGES NEEDED and QA said FAIL, yet each `agent.complete` unblocked the
next stage as if green: QA verified the pre-fix head (933ea6f), CI certified the pre-fix head
(12e9ac6), and the fix (TEAM-4183 → 001259d) landed 3 seconds before `workflow.complete` with no
re-review, re-QA or re-CI. The handed-off PR #47 head is unverified by the pipeline. Third
recurrence of the unverified-follow-on-fix gap on this def, and the first where explicit FAIL
verdicts were overridden by flow.

## Scores

| dimension | score | one-liner |
|---|---|---|
| planning | 84 | 9-ticket serial chain correct; PO decision from Spec Approval lost between spec→design→plan |
| execution | 72 | 7.19M ms, 0 errors/nudges/retries; verification ran on the wrong head; $450 for a 5-file feature |
| reviewEfficiency | 66 | human gates fast in practice (metric overstates); agent verdicts not enforced by the orchestrator |
| reworkDiscipline | 60 | 1 fix, 4/4 findings closed, +7 tests, 0 resurfacing — but zero verification of the fixed head |
| **overall** | **71** | |

## Timeline (from metrics.agentTasks / events)

| ticket | agent | invoked | done | durationMs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| TEAM-4164 Requirements | requirements_analyst | 21:48:32 | 22:08:05 | 1,172,864 |
| TEAM-4175 Design | frontend_designer | 22:09:40 | 22:25:45 | 965,111 |
| TEAM-4177 Plan | frontend_dev | 22:30:31 | 22:41:48 | 676,804 |
| TEAM-4179 Implement | frontend_dev | 22:45:27 | 23:04:08 | 1,121,034 |
| TEAM-4180 Review → CHANGES NEEDED | code_reviewer | 23:04:08 | 23:19:21 | 913,726 |
| TEAM-4183 Fix (review) | frontend_dev | 23:18:06 | 23:46:57 | 1,731,344 (longest task) |
| TEAM-4181 QA → FAIL | qa_verifier | 23:19:21 | 23:36:32 | 1,031,258 |
| TEAM-4182 CI → PASS @12e9ac6 (caveated) | ci_agent | 23:36:32 | 23:42:11 | 338,908 |
| workflow.complete (PR #47, handoff) | orchestrator | — | 23:47:00 | — |

Phases: design 1,251,433ms · development 2,930,053ms · verification 1,657,141ms.
Human gates (metrics.humanReviews): TEAM-4163 intent 3,483,659ms · TEAM-4174 spec 2,234,942ms ·
TEAM-4176 design 1,177,178ms · TEAM-4178 plan 216,014ms · humanWaitTotalMs=7,111,793 (all 4 outsideHours).

## 1. Planning (84)

- The requirements analyst (TEAM-4164) produced a coherent playbook chain: intent (verbatim) → spec R1–R10
  with Given/When/Then → Spec Approval → Design → Design Approval → Plan → Plan Approval → Implement →
  Review → QA → CI. Chain deliberately ends at CI (CD_REGISTERED=false, handoff) — correct for this repo.
  No duplicate assignee/tier; frontend_dev's Plan/Implement tickets serially chained by design.
- Six open Concerns were carried forward honestly rather than silently resolved. Good.
- Gap A — **decision loss across artifacts**: the PO resolved Concern 3 at Spec Approval (TEAM-4174,
  "5000 ms; pause the countdown while Undo has focus or hover") and restated it at Design Approval
  (TEAM-4176). Design (TEAM-4175) argued against a focus-pause and plan (TEAM-4177) recorded "no
  focus-pause" — but neither took it back to the PO, and every Concern row stayed `open`. The reviewer's
  F1 (P1) is exactly this. Two human gates produced a decision the pipeline had no mechanism to bind.
- Gap B — **intake context incomplete**: TEAM-4164 reports its Workflow Context lacked the
  `## SDLC Framework` and `## Human Review Gates` blocks; it reverse-engineered gate wording and
  branch/artifact conventions from the prior playbook run (wf_1788672380233_ymo7dm). Worked, but fragile.
- Gap C — **fix ticket created with blockedBy=[] and no downstream re-verification**: TEAM-4183 was
  filed at 23:18:03 in phase=development while QA/CI still had blockedBy=[TEAM-4180]/[TEAM-4181] only.
  Nothing in the ticket plan made QA or CI depend on the fix, and no "re-review" ticket exists.

## 2. Execution (72)

- Wall clock 7,189,776ms — the fastest software-delivery feature run since the healthy baselines
  (bake-off arms 13.4M–18.1M ms; f50ucz 91.6M ms). errors=0, nudges=0, retries=0, 1 session per task.
- Critical path was agent work throughout; the fix TEAM-4183 (1,731,344ms) was the longest single task
  and ran fully in parallel with QA (1,031,258ms) + CI (338,908ms). Parallelism saved wall time but
  made the verification phase verify the wrong head (see §4).
- Cost (shared/cost-report.json, workflow.performance): totalCostUsd=450.02 (persona $423.54,
  coding $26.48), tokens total 51,475,968, cache hit 45.9%, perTaskUsd=56.25. Bands: z=0.46 vs def
  median $341.23 — inside "ok", but for a 5-source-file brownfield delta this is expensive; the 4
  human-gate review packages + verbatim artifact mirroring are the plausible drivers (not measured per task).
- Manager interventions: 1 (comment on TEAM-4181 at 23:31:04Z — watch triage judged QA alive from
  lastText, no action). Correct call: QA completed 5.5 min later. No cost to the run.
- Data-quality: no token_usage events (per-run tokens come only from the performance card).

## 3. Human-in-the-loop (66)

- Four human gates, all approved, all outsideHours. metrics.humanWaitTotalMs=7,111,793 (99% of wall
  clock) — but this number is an artifact of Jira bookkeeping, not of blocking. The event log shows the
  orchestrator released downstream work minutes after each review.needed:
  TEAM-4163 review.needed 21:47:13 → orchestrator.unblocked TEAM-4164 21:48:32;
  TEAM-4174 22:08:05 → TEAM-4175 released 22:09:40;
  TEAM-4176 22:25:45 → TEAM-4177 released 22:30:31;
  TEAM-4178 22:41:48 → TEAM-4179 released 22:45:27.
  The four gate tickets were then closed in Jira as a batch at 22:45:16–22:45:24, which is the
  `resolvedAt` the metric keys on. Real blocking wait was on the order of minutes per gate, not hours.
  → Data-quality finding: humanWait should key on the agent.complete/unblock of the gate ticket, not
  the Jira transition. (The performance card repeats the same inflated humanWaitMs=7,185,107.)
- Gate ROI: Spec Approval (TEAM-4174) did real work — it recorded a PO decision on Concern 3. Design
  Approval restated it. Plan Approval (TEAM-4178) approved a plan that contradicted it. So the human
  gates carried the right information; the system failed to make it binding. Intent Acceptance
  (TEAM-4163) was a pure pass-through.
- Agent verdict gates: code_reviewer TEAM-4180 = CHANGES NEEDED (F1 P1, F2 P2, F2b P3, F3 P3), QA
  TEAM-4181 = FAIL (191 PASS / 8 FAIL live rows, all four findings reproduced in Chromium at 1280 and
  320), CI TEAM-4182 = PASS with explicit caveat "covers head 12e9ac6 only; if TEAM-4183 pushes new
  commits, CI must be re-run". All three agents were right and said so plainly. None of the verdicts
  changed the orchestrator's behaviour — each agent.complete unblocked its successor.

## 4. Rework (60) — the core failure of this run

Sequence (events + completions):
1. 23:18:03 reviewer files TEAM-4183 (codex_fix, status=ready, blockedBy=[]); 23:18:06 orchestrator
   dispatches frontend_dev on it immediately.
2. 23:19:21 reviewer's agent.complete unblocks QA TEAM-4181 — despite verdict CHANGES NEEDED.
3. 23:19–23:36 QA verifies head 933ea6f (pre-fix), correctly FAILs, comments the live repro + fix
   contract onto TEAM-4183, and writes "QA must re-run at TEAM-4183's head".
4. 23:36:32 QA's agent.complete unblocks CI TEAM-4182 — despite verdict FAIL.
5. 23:36–23:42 CI PASSes head 12e9ac6 (QA evidence commit; src still pre-fix) with the re-run caveat.
6. 23:46:57 TEAM-4183 completes: all 4 findings fixed, PR #46 merged into the integration branch at
   001259d, 64/64 tests (+7), lint/build green, hover-pause screenshot. Its `unblocked` is [].
7. 23:47:00 workflow.complete, delivery=handoff, prUrl=PR #47.

What never happened: re-review of TEAM-4183 (its own ticket text says "evidence the reviewer verifies
on re-review"); QA at 001259d; CI at 001259d. Deviation D1 (hover-pause only, no focus-pause) is an
OPEN PO decision shipped inside the handoff. Metrics/perf card report reworkRounds=0, gateRounds=0,
firstPassYield=1 — all wrong; compute_metrics does count fixTickets=1 (title "Fix (review)").
Agent-side discipline was good: 1 ticket, 4/4 findings closed with per-finding evidence, 0
resurfacing, 0 fix-induced. The 60 is for the system: a fix landed with zero pipeline verification.

## 5. Deliverables vs. intent

Intent successCriteria → evidence:
- "Clear activity control empties the feed" — TEAM-4179 clearActivities(); QA live PASS (seed-25 → 0 li, storage '[]').
- "~5 s Undo restores exactly what was cleared" — QA live PASS (same 20 in same order, 25 ids restored; Undo present @4907ms, gone @5202ms).
- "after that permanent, survives reload" — QA live PASS (reload inside window → empty; reload after undo → 25).
- "keyboard + screen-reader users can do both" — keyboard PASS; screen-reader F2/F2b FAILED at QA head, fixed in TEAM-4183 but not re-verified by QA.
- "tests cover clear, undo, expiry, reload; existing pass; build green" — 57/57 at CI head, 64/64 at fix head (dev-reported); existing 37 untouched (CI: additions-only diff verified).
- Constraints — App.tsx/App.css/package.json byte-identical to main, no DEPLOY.md, no new deps: verified by QA and CI.
Artifacts: 35 (intent, spec, design doc + 3 mockups, plan, findings, QA report + 7 screenshots + live log,
CI report, 4 review packages, cost/performance cards, manifest). Complete artifact set for a playbook run.
Net: the feature very likely works at 001259d, but the pipeline can only *attest* to 12e9ac6.

## 6. Trend (5 prior analyses on this def)

f50ucz 72 (09-06, 91.6M ms) · r30dhl 78 · d68649 80 · 29g73c 74 · xm2bmz 80. This run 71.
Deltas vs f50ucz: duration −84,427,668ms; humanWait +3,917,879ms (metric artifact, see §3);
changeRequests 0 → 0; overall −1.
- Unverified-follow-on-fix gap: now 3 runs (f50ucz mitigated via ship-review r2 + CI re-cert; yteqfl;
  this run with no mitigation because the chain has no Ship stage). Confirmed recurring, P0 in playbook mode.
- QA-parallel-with-fix: 3rd sighting (f50ucz TEAM-4124/4131, sffzti, this run) — worst instance: QA
  FAILed and was still treated as green.
- TEAM-3268 missed-re-wake family: NOT observed (no Ship ticket in this chain, so no exposure).
- Playbook overlay (2nd run): 2h vs ymo7dm 4.6M ms/$191 — faster but 2.35× the cost. Both playbook
  runs had a QA-stage event (ymo7dm crash, this run verdict override).
